dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, moderate-rate narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral margins where the skin meets the water appear smooth and continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a uniform light-grey/blueish tint across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several faint, thin linear marks on the posterior dorsal surface near the tail.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor, superficial linear scratches or rake marks are visible on the lower third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, centrally-aligned dorsal ridge and a distinct, open blowhole aperture.
